ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Project delivery, Mobilising and later stages need Project manager and Planned completion.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Pre-start", 1, "Mobilising", 2, "On site", 3, "Snagging", 4, "Defects period", 5, "Closed out", 6, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(Project_manager__c), ISBLANK(Planned_completion_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Project manager and Planned completion before moving to Mobilising.
